The Agent Arena Hackathon
San Francisco, CASep 26 at 9:00 AM – Sep 27 at 5:00 PM (PDT)

Join us at The Agent Arena Hackathon hosted by Vultr to build what the next generation of agent infrastructure actually looks like in production.

Agents are writing code, driving browsers, and running real operations for teams. The infrastructure built to contain and coordinate what they do needs to get better.

Vultr is bringing the tools for you to build infrastructure powering the next generation of autonomous execution: VM backends, serverless inference, and the compute layer agents run on when they stop talking and start acting.

Compete for more than $10,000 across cash and credits!

Note: This event is fully in-person in San Francisco. Teams may have up to four members. All attendees must apply and be approved. Submitting an application does not guarantee a seat; approved applicants must confirm their attendance.

Data & AI Hackathon is an 8-hour hackathon at the AWS Builder Loft in San Francisco on September 11, 2026 (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM).

Join us for Data & AI Hackathon, an electrifying 8-hour hackathon bringing together the brightest minds in tech, creativity, and innovation — all under one roof at the iconic AWS Builder Loft in San Francisco.
Whether you're a seasoned hacker, a budding developer, a design wizard, or an idea machine, Data & AI Hackathon is your chance to build, learn, and connect with some of the most passionate problem-solvers in the Bay Area tech community.
🚀 Theme
Thoughtful Agents for Productivity
Build intelligent tools and AI-powered agents that enhance productivity, automate workflows, and help people accomplish more with less effort.
🗓️ Event Details
Date: September 11, 2026
Time: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM
Location: AWS Builder Loft, San Francisco
💡 What to Expect
Participants can look forward to an exciting day filled with:
⚡ High-energy hacking sessions
🧠 Challenges designed to inspire impactful products
🧑‍🏫 Mentorship from industry experts
🎁 Swag, snacks, and networking opportunities
🏆 Exciting prizes for top teams
🎤 A chance to demo your project to industry leaders
🌟 Who Should Attend?
Developers & Engineers
AI / ML Enthusiasts
Designers & Product Thinkers
Students & Startup Builders
Anyone passionate about building innovative tech
Register now at: https://events.builder.aws.com/vBELdw 
Seats are limited, and this event is expected to fill up quickly. Secure your spot and be part of a community building the next generation of intelligent tools.
Let’s hack, build, and innovate together at Data & AI Hackathon
